notesId:
Baru di v1.5.208:
- App sekarang punya folder sendiri di Android/data/dev.wndavenz.music.
- APK update diunduh ke folder itu dan dipakai ulang klo sudah pernah diunduh - ga download ulang lg.
- Halaman Log sekarang bisa menyimpan log ke file di folder itu (files/logs).

Perbaikan di v1.5.209:
- Indeks antrean tidak lagi mendarat di lagu yg salah saat ada lagu dihapus di tengah crossfade.
- Kegagalan memasang update sekarang menampilkan error, bukan menutup dialog seolah berhasil.
notesEn:
What's new in v1.5.208:
- The app now has its own folder in Android/data/dev.wndavenz.music.
- Update APKs download into that folder and are reused when already downloaded - no more re-downloading the same update.
- The Log page can now save logs to a file in that folder (files/logs).

Fixes in v1.5.209:
- Fixed the queue index landing on the wrong track when a song was removed during a crossfade.
- Update install failures now show an error instead of closing the dialog as if they succeeded.
